guide_notes: Batch authors copy guide examples verbatim as drill sentences (Marco e Giulia sono stanchi; Le pareti della camera sono rosa); the guide or author brief should say examples must not be reused.

The mixed-plural rule is stated for predicate adjectives; the guide does not say that right after the nouns (attributive position) agreement with the nearest noun also occurs, so items should keep to the predicate position, as this batch does.

spelling-plurals: the stress wording ('stress falls just before it' / 'stressed before the last two syllables') is easy to misread; naming the stressed syllable (te-DE-sco vs sim-PA-ti-co) would be clearer.
